subject: Basic Applied Mathematics
provisional_note: Semester 1 (Jul-Dec 2026) follows the official MoEST 2026 calendar. Semester 2 (Jan-May 2027) is inferred from the 2026 pattern and ends before the ACSEE examinations - replace it with the published 2026/2027 almanac before relying on those dates.

entries.main_competence: 1.0   Use applied mathematical knowledge and skills
entries.specific_competence: 1.1   Use some advanced skills in geometry, trigonometry, and vectors to solve problems in different contexts
entries.learning_activity: (a) Explore some advanced tenets of coordinate geometry (area of a triangle, angle between two lines and perpendicular distance from a point to a line)
teaching_learning_activities: Discovery method: Allow students to contextualize coordinate geometry into everyday life and explore its tenets by hypothesizing, experiment, justify findings and share their conclusions.
Drill and practice: Guide students to perform several tasks on the tenets of coordinate geometry
entries.assessment: Some advanced tenets of Coordinate geometry are well explored
entries.references: TIE, Basic Applied Mathematics for Advanced Secondary Schools Form Six: Student's Book and Teacher's Guide, Tanzania Institute of Education

entries.main_competence: 1.0   Use applied mathematical knowledge and skills
entries.specific_competence: 1.1   Use some advanced skills in geometry, trigonometry, and vectors to solve problems in different contexts
entries.learning_activity: (b) Explore some advanced tenets of vectors (unit vector, scalar product, cross product, angle between two vectors and work done by a constant force, derivative and integration of vector functions)
teaching_learning_activities: Group discussion: Allow students to work in groups to relate vectors in everyday life and explore its tenets through visual representations, manipulatives, technological tools and reporting of findings
Questions and answers: Equip students with suitable vector materials, assign them questions and allow them to present their findings
entries.assessment: Some advanced tenets of vector is well explored
entries.references: TIE, Basic Applied Mathematics for Advanced Secondary Schools Form Six: Student's Book and Teacher's Guide, Tanzania Institute of Education

entries.main_competence: 1.0   Use applied mathematical knowledge and skills
entries.specific_competence: 1.2 Use statistics to solve problems in different contexts
entries.learning_activity: Explore some advanced tenets of statistics (measure of central tendency and dispersion: calculate mean by the coding method, variance, standard deviation, quartiles, and percentiles)
teaching_learning_activities: Study tour: Organise a study tour and allow students to collect data from a visited organisation. Guide them to explore some basic tenets of statistics and allow them to present their findings
Questions and answers: Assign statistics questions and allow students to present and discuss their findings
entries.assessment: Some advanced tenets of statistics are well explored
entries.references: TIE, Basic Applied Mathematics for Advanced Secondary Schools Form Six: Student's Book and Teacher's Guide, Tanzania Institute of Education
